description: Get the full details of one bank bonus: every requirement step, the bonus amount or tiers, the deadline, the fees and how to avoid them, who is eligible and in which states, whether the bank does a hard credit pull, when the bonus is paid, and the apply link. Use it after find_bonuses, or when a person names a bank or an account, such as 'the Chase Total Checking bonus' or 'is the SoFi bonus still live'. Pass bonus_id from find_bonuses, or a bank or account name.

name.description: A bank or account name, such as Chase Total Checking or SoFi, when there is no bonus_id.

state.description: The person's state, to add the conditions that apply there.

name: get_bonus
title: Get one bank bonus in full
